desc:
Welcome to your very own boarding house!

Start with a small house and turn it into a successful boarding house. Manage tenants, unlock new rooms, collect rent, repair utilities, decorate your property, and grow your business!

🔑 Unlock & Upgrade Rooms
🛏️ Expand your boarding house and create more spaces for tenants.

👨‍👩‍👧 Manage Tenants
Welcome new tenants, assign them rooms, and keep your boarding house running smoothly.

💰 Collect Rent & Earn Cash
Use your earnings to improve your house and unlock new opportunities.

🔧 Repair & Maintain
Fix broken utilities and keep your tenants happy.

🎨 Decorate Your Boarding House
Customize your rooms with furniture, colors, materials, and cosmetics.

⭐ Build Your Reputation
Provide a better boarding experience and grow your business.

Experience Filipino Boarding House Life!

Can you build the biggest and most successful boarding house?

More features and updates coming soon!
